title: Application role granted to a Microsoft Entra service principal
description: Detects successful app-role assignments to Microsoft Entra service principals. The operation alone does not reveal permission severity or malicious intent; use it for change monitoring and correlation.

hypothesis.summary: An adversary may grant additional application permissions to a service principal to expand or preserve cloud access.
hypothesis.rationale: An app-role assignment can give a service principal access to an API and its protected data, but the operation alone does not reveal whether the assigned permission is privileged or approved.
hypothesis.detection_goal: Identify successful app-role assignments to service principals while leaving failures, removals, delegated grants, and incomplete events unmatched.

triage.summary: Identify the initiator, service principal, resource API, and granted app role, then compare the change with the approved application-permission record.
steps: Resolve the initiating user or workload, target service principal, resource API, and app-role value from InitiatedBy and TargetResources.
Determine the effective permission scope, whether admin consent was required, and whether the assignment is covered by an approved onboarding or change request.
Review adjacent credential, owner, consent, and sign-in activity, then remove unauthorized permissions and investigate the initiating identity.
Treat this as change or policy monitoring; correlate with actor risk and an approved change record before opening an incident.
false_positives: Approved application onboarding, API permission changes, automation deployment, or identity-lifecycle activity

validation.expected_outcome: Match only a successful Add app role assignment to service principal operation; do not match failures, removals, delegated grants, or events without a result.

limitations: Authorized administration can produce this event. The rule does not independently establish compromise or completion of a command; assess identity, target and change approval.
Current-revision evidence is synthetic only. Validate full generated KQL, source fields, ingestion delay, alert volume and scoped exclusions in the target before enabling.
